image_context.title: Image context and processing
image_context.description: One row per submitted image file or volume. Describe the submitted representation and preserve the source acquisition context separately.
fields: State whether the file is a 3D volume, 4D volume, slice, projection, screenshot, whole-slide image or derived image.
Reference the source image using an agreed de-identified identifier or relative path. Preserve source DICOM UIDs only when available and permitted by the curator. Do not invent DICOM UIDs.
Identify the visit or longitudinal time point using the same labels across imaging and supporting tables.
Voxel or pixel spacing of the submitted radiology image in file-axis order, in mm. Document axis order. This may differ from source acquisition spacing.
Explain file axis order, including spatial, time and channel axes when applicable.
Describe the coordinate convention, orientation and location or reference the file header/affine. Preserve the spatial transform, including after reorientation or registration.
NIfTI header affine; RAS+ world coordinates in mm
Units of submitted pixel or voxel values. State whether values are quantitative, arbitrary or transformed, and how transforms affect interpretation.
Describe conversion software/version and subsequent reorientation, registration, interpolation, cropping, resampling, normalization, clipping or compression.
Fictional example: converted to NIfTI, resampled to 1 mm isotropic with linear interpolation; no intensity normalization
For separate 2D slices, identify their original volume/series and ordering. Distinguish slice spacing from nominal slice thickness.
Explain unavailable or not-applicable metadata. Do not replace missing measurements with zero or infer acquisition settings from appearance.

ct_acquisition.title: CT acquisition
ct_acquisition.description: One row per submitted CT file or volume. Report source acquisition/reconstruction values when known.

mr_acquisition.title: MR acquisition
mr_acquisition.description: One row per submitted MR file or volume. Preserve multiple echoes, diffusion b-values and temporal structure rather than selecting a single representative value.

pet_acquisition.title: PET acquisition
pet_acquisition.description: One row per submitted PET file or volume. Record the original quantitative units and any conversion or SUV normalization applied to the submitted image.

contrast.title: Contrast administration
contrast.description: One row per submitted image file or volume with known contrast information. Distinguish no contrast from an unavailable administration record.

slide_details.title: Slide microscopy details
slide_details.description: One row per submitted slide image. Report the submitted image dimensions and resolution, retaining specimen/slide linkage agreed with your curator.

annotation_details.title: Annotations and source images
annotation_details.description: One row per segment, region or annotation group. Keep labels, codes and algorithms paired on the same row.
fields: Identifier for the individual segment, region or annotation group within the dataset.
Exact relative path of the submitted image the annotation applies to. Subject-level linkage alone does not identify the annotated image.
Value identifying the segment or region in the annotation file; document background and overlapping labels.
Meaning of this specific segment or annotation, distinct from the anatomy originally scanned.
Describe whether the annotation was manual, automatic or semiautomatic and explain any human editing.
Software/model name and version used to create or edit the annotation.
Explain coordinate space, units and any transform needed to align with the source image.
Same voxel grid and affine as source NIfTI

field_notes.radiology.pixel_spacing_row: The upstream description specifies a row/column pair in mm despite the singular field name. Preserve both values and confirm the delimiter with your curator. Additional modality tables use separate row and column fields.
field_notes.file.file_id: The upstream description says this identifier is generated by the CRDC Submission Portal. Ask your curator how it should be handled; leave it blank in preparation examples.
field_notes.procedure.procedure_date: Discuss permitted de-identified dates or time-point representations with your curator. Do not supply original identifying dates through this guide.
field_notes.radiology.patient_age_at_imaging: The model describes DICOM-style ages, such as 063Y. Confirm the permitted representation and any age protection with your curator.
field_notes.diagnosis.age_at_diagnosis: Use the units and representation agreed with your curator. Do not assume that age at diagnosis and age at imaging are interchangeable.
